name: SUCKR
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The SUCKR project on the Aptos chain is suspected of being a rug pull. The hacker called the mint_SUCKR (admin privilege function) function to mint a large number of SUCKR tokens and exchange them for USDT. The price of SUCKR tokens plummeted by 9% 249h.
